title: From AIOps Pipelines to Agentic Service Operations: A Survey of Capability, Authority, and Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.21620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern service systems combine rapidly changing dependencies, heterogeneous telemetry, and operational actions whose side effects may amplify an incident. Conventional AIOps research has produced effective detectors, localizers, and diagnostic models, yet surveys typically organize them by task, telemetry modality, or learning technique. Such taxonomies describe what a method predicts, but not which decisions it may make or which evidence justifies that authority. We survey the transition from AIOps pipelines to agentic service operations through three coupled lenses: capability, operational authority, and evaluation evidence. We first relate SOA, microservices, Kubernetes, service meshes, and serverless platforms to the incident lifecycle. We then review conventional AIOps methods and audit 22 language-model-enabled systems according to their evaluated behavior rather than their intended autonomy. translated_title: 从AIOps流水线到智能体化服务运营：能力、权限与证据的综述
translated_abstract: 现代服务系统集成了快速变化的依赖关系、异构的遥测数据，以及其副作用可能放大故障的运维操作。传统的AIOps研究已经产生了有效的检测器、定位器和诊断模型，但现有综述通常按照任务、遥测模态或学习技术来组织这些方法。这种分类方式只描述了方法能够预测什么，却没有说明它可以做出哪些决策，以及何种证据能够支撑其权限。本文从三个相互关联的视角——能力、运维权限和评估证据——综述了从AIOps流水线向智能体化服务运营的转变。我们首先将SOA、微服务、Kubernetes、服务网格和无服务器平台与故障生命周期联系起来，然后回顾了传统的AIOps方法，并根据22个基于语言模型的系统的实际评估行为（而非其预期的自主性）对它们进行了审计。审计结果表明，大多数系统仍然……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该综述提出以能力、运维权限和评估证据三个相互关联的视角来审视从传统AIOps流水线到智能体化服务运营的转变，并依据实际评估行为而非预期自主性对22个语言模型驱动的系统进行了审计。
en_tdlr: This survey examines the transition from AIOps pipelines to agentic service operations through three coupled lenses—capability, operational authority, and evaluation evidence—and audits 22 language-model-enabled systems based on their evaluated behavior rather than their intended autonomy.
